**Pro tip**: To search within a specific collection, open it first, then tap the search field.

Results are grouped by type so you can jump to the right one.
For bookmarks, results match against title, description, URL, tags, and notes.
Need to narrow things down? Use [filters](/filters){.link} to refine your results by attributes, date, and more.

## [](#searching-inside-content){.anchor-link aria-label="Navigate to header: Searching inside content"}Searching inside content {#searching-inside-content .flex .whitespace-pre-wrap .group .font-medium aria-labelledby="_R_b9armhkd74t9_"}

Search doesn't stop at titles, tags, and notes --- it also looks inside the content you saved. Type a phrase you remember reading, and you'll find the bookmark even if those words never appear in the title.

- ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,){.forced-colors:forced-color-adjust-none .forced-colors:bg-[color:CanvasText]! .icon .inline .bg-primary .dark:bg-primary-light} **Saved web pages** --- the full text of the [web archive](/web-archive){.link} copy
- ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,){.forced-colors:forced-color-adjust-none .forced-colors:bg-[color:CanvasText]! .icon .inline .bg-primary .dark:bg-primary-light} **PDF & EPUB files** --- every page of the document
- ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,){.forced-colors:forced-color-adjust-none .forced-colors:bg-[color:CanvasText]! .icon .inline .bg-primary .dark:bg-primary-light} **YouTube videos** --- spoken words from the video transcript

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBhcmlhLWhpZGRlbj0idHJ1ZSIgd2lkdGg9IjE4IiBoZWlnaHQ9IjE4IiBzdHJva2Utd2lkdGg9IjEuNSIgY2xhc3M9InNpemUtNCB0ZXh0LWJsdWUtODAwIGRhcms6dGV4dC1ibHVlLTMwMCI+PHVzZSBocmVmPSIjbWktbWludC0xLUNhbGxvdXROb3RlIiAvPjwvc3ZnPg==){.size-4 .text-blue-800 .dark:text-blue-300}

Searching inside web pages, PDF and EPUB files, and YouTube transcripts requires a [Pro plan](/premium-features){.link}.

## [](#matching-by-meaning){.anchor-link aria-label="Navigate to header: Matching by meaning"}Matching by meaning {#matching-by-meaning .flex .whitespace-pre-wrap .group .font-medium aria-labelledby="_R_j9armhkd74t9_"}

You don't need the exact words. Search also matches by meaning, so a query like `morning routine` can surface a bookmark titled `how I start my day` --- even with no shared words.
For anything trickier, ask [Stella](/stella){.link} --- the built-in AI assistant. Open a chat and describe what you're looking for in your own words --- `that article about morning routines`, `the Italian recipe with the weird ingredient`, `travel tips for Tokyo from that blogger`.

![](https://mintcdn.com/raindropio-0c6b7ca1/g7d24I8ROfahz7TM/assets/stella-intro.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=g7d24I8ROfahz7TM&q=85&s=2a287b756e416e1a9838777c3dc03f06){.object-contain path="assets/stella-intro.png" width="2036" height="1060" decoding="async" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 696px" srcset="https://mintcdn.com/raindropio-0c6b7ca1/g7d24I8ROfahz7TM/assets/stella-intro.png?w=280&fit=max&auto=format&n=g7d24I8ROfahz7TM&q=85&s=38dfb3b0bde8e041806703b4a896ebc5 280w, https://mintcdn.com/raindropio-0c6b7ca1/g7d24I8ROfahz7TM/assets/stella-intro.png?w=560&fit=max&auto=format&n=g7d24I8ROfahz7TM&q=85&s=0e741db9c5bbab3dc1f2b32fc106d4f8 560w, https://mintcdn.com/raindropio-0c6b7ca1/g7d24I8ROfahz7TM/assets/stella-intro.png?w=840&fit=max&auto=format&n=g7d24I8ROfahz7TM&q=85&s=c6e4afa719bfc37d4669be52901ef6eb 840w, https://mintcdn.com/raindropio-0c6b7ca1/g7d24I8ROfahz7TM/assets/stella-intro.png?w=1100&fit=max&auto=format&n=g7d24I8ROfahz7TM&q=85&s=9be3b0eb5e777bd7a0feb939b93f438f 1100w, https://mintcdn.com/raindropio-0c6b7ca1/g7d24I8ROfahz7TM/assets/stella-intro.png?w=1650&fit=max&auto=format&n=g7d24I8ROfahz7TM&q=85&s=b310771b9e94d0a664f0ece8cb43f1fc 1650w, https://mintcdn.com/raindropio-0c6b7ca1/g7d24I8ROfahz7TM/assets/stella-intro.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=g7d24I8ROfahz7TM&q=85&s=94c1fad7f480a475cf07f623ed8cf82d 2500w" optimize="true" style="aspect-ratio:2036 / 1060"}

## [](#searching-from-the-browser-address-bar){.anchor-link aria-label="Navigate to header: Searching from the browser address bar"}Searching from the browser address bar {#searching-from-the-browser-address-bar .flex .whitespace-pre-wrap .group .font-medium aria-labelledby="_R_r9armhkd74t9_"}

You don't even need to open Raindrop.io --- search straight from your browser's address bar without leaving the page you're on. Enter `rd` in the address bar, press **Tab**, and type your query.

## [](#limitations){.anchor-link aria-label="Navigate to header: Limitations"}Limitations {#limitations .flex .whitespace-pre-wrap .group .font-medium aria-labelledby="_R_139armhkd74t9_"}

- New bookmarks need a few minutes before page content is indexed
- Text inside images is not searchable (no OCR)

## [](#faq){.anchor-link aria-label="Navigate to header: FAQ"}FAQ {#faq .flex .whitespace-pre-wrap .group .font-medium aria-labelledby="_R_1b9armhkd74t9_"}

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBhcmlhLWhpZGRlbj0idHJ1ZSIgd2lkdGg9IjE4IiBoZWlnaHQ9IjE4IiBzdHJva2Utd2lkdGg9IjEuNSIgY2xhc3M9InNpemUtMyBzaHJpbmstMCB0ZXh0LWdyYXktNjAwIHRyYW5zaXRpb24tdHJhbnNmb3JtIGR1cmF0aW9uLTIwMCBkYXJrOnRleHQtZ3JheS00MDAgLXJvdGF0ZS05MCI+PHVzZSBocmVmPSIjbWktbWludC0xLUNhcmV0RG93biIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.size-3 .shrink-0 .text-gray-600 .transition-transform .duration-200 .dark:text-gray-400 .-rotate-90}

Can I combine text search with filters?

Yes. Type in the search field while one or more [filters](/filters){.link} are active. The results will match both your search query and every selected filter.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBhcmlhLWhpZGRlbj0idHJ1ZSIgd2lkdGg9IjE4IiBoZWlnaHQ9IjE4IiBzdHJva2Utd2lkdGg9IjEuNSIgY2xhc3M9InNpemUtMyBzaHJpbmstMCB0ZXh0LWdyYXktNjAwIHRyYW5zaXRpb24tdHJhbnNmb3JtIGR1cmF0aW9uLTIwMCBkYXJrOnRleHQtZ3JheS00MDAgLXJvdGF0ZS05MCI+PHVzZSBocmVmPSIjbWktbWludC0xLUNhcmV0RG93biIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.size-3 .shrink-0 .text-gray-600 .transition-transform .duration-200 .dark:text-gray-400 .-rotate-90}

Can\'t find something?

- **Saved it just now?** Title, description, and URL are searchable right away, but page content needs a few minutes to index.
- **Deleted it?** Bookmarks in [Trash](/bookmarks#where-deleted-bookmarks-go){.link} don't appear in search results. Restore the bookmark first.
- **Try asking [Stella](/stella){.link}** --- describe what you're looking for in your own words, it's often the fastest way.
- **Can't find text from the page?** Make sure the bookmark has a [web archive](/web-archive){.link} copy --- it's required for page content search.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBhcmlhLWhpZGRlbj0idHJ1ZSIgd2lkdGg9IjE4IiBoZWlnaHQ9IjE4IiBzdHJva2Utd2lkdGg9IjEuNSIgY2xhc3M9InNpemUtMyBzaHJpbmstMCB0ZXh0LWdyYXktNjAwIHRyYW5zaXRpb24tdHJhbnNmb3JtIGR1cmF0aW9uLTIwMCBkYXJrOnRleHQtZ3JheS00MDAgLXJvdGF0ZS05MCI+PHVzZSBocmVmPSIjbWktbWludC0xLUNhcmV0RG93biIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.size-3 .shrink-0 .text-gray-600 .transition-transform .duration-200 .dark:text-gray-400 .-rotate-90}

How do I search for an exact phrase?

Wrap it in quotes: `"css grid"`. You can also exclude words with a minus sign: `-superman`. See [all available operators](/filters#need-more-precise-filtering){.link} in the Filters article.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBhcmlhLWhpZGRlbj0idHJ1ZSIgd2lkdGg9IjE4IiBoZWlnaHQ9IjE4IiBzdHJva2Utd2lkdGg9IjEuNSIgY2xhc3M9InNpemUtMyBzaHJpbmstMCB0ZXh0LWdyYXktNjAwIHRyYW5zaXRpb24tdHJhbnNmb3JtIGR1cmF0aW9uLTIwMCBkYXJrOnRleHQtZ3JheS00MDAgLXJvdGF0ZS05MCI+PHVzZSBocmVmPSIjbWktbWludC0xLUNhcmV0RG93biIgLz48L3N2Zz4=){.size-3 .shrink-0 .text-gray-600 .transition-transform .duration-200 .dark:text-gray-400 .-rotate-90}

Can I limit search to title and description only?

Yes. Select **In title/description** from the search field suggestions, or type `info:` before your query.
